calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, s.store_id < 900 AS is_store, f.channel_code, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date),
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatches
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT store_key) FROM dim_store) AS dup_store_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT product_key) FROM dim_product) AS dup_prod_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22') AS test_lines_in_stores,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_key IS NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22') AS orphan_store,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.channel_code='ST' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)) AS st_web_overlap,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND (f.net_amount<0 OR f.quantity<=0)) AS negative_lines

calls.statement:
SELECT 'sales' AS part, f.vat_rate, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat, count(*) AS n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', r.vat_rate, sum(r.refund_net), sum(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net), count(*)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'control', NULL, sum(net_sales_before_returns), sum(returns_net), sum(receipts)
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id < 900
ORDER BY 1, 2
